items.name: Terraforma
items.why:
Experimental music festival in the park of Villa Arconati: sound installations and long-form listening.
fits: Your electroacoustic music and hybrid compositions, and The Great Silence, a saga made with more than fifty artists including multimedia artist Andrew Quinn.

items.name: Club To Club
items.why:
Italy's reference for forward-looking electronic and avant-pop; a stage for crossover live sets.
fits: Your hip-hop and lo-fi productions and electroacoustic music: a crossover live set next to your classical piano work.

items.name: Romaeuropa Festival
items.why:
Multidisciplinary festival: music, dance, theatre and digital work.
fits: Asombros, your concerto for magician and ensemble with illusionists Diego Allegri and Nicolò Tosin, and The Great Silence, which joins music with architecture, sculpture and multimedia.

items.name: La Biennale di Venezia — Musica
items.why:
Contemporary music sector with Biennale College calls for young composers and performers.
fits: Your post-minimalist operas, polytonal chamber music and hybrid compositions, backed by top-mark degrees with honours in Piano and Chamber Music.

items.name: MITO SettembreMusica
items.why:
Large classical/contemporary festival with piano recitals and new commissions.
fits: Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, your signature piece, and Ives's Concord Sonata played with Franco Maschio's sculpture Marilyn. Your 2021 Trieste programme was all Gershwin.

items.name: Ravenna Festival
items.why:
Interdisciplinary summer festival mixing music, theatre and dance in historic sites.
fits: Asombros, which brings music and illusion together on stage, and The Great Silence, made with more than fifty artists across disciplines.

items.name: Flussi
items.why:
Digital arts and electronic music festival — sound installation and audiovisual work.
fits: Your electroacoustic music, improvisations and conceptual art exercises, and the live experimental film you are working on.

items.name: Unsound
items.why:
Adventurous music festival with commissioned audiovisual and installation projects.
fits: Your electroacoustic and lo-fi work, hybrid compositions, and the live experimental film you are working on.

items.name: CTM Festival
items.why:
Adventurous music & art festival with exhibitions and open calls (e.g. radio lab).
fits: Your electroacoustic music and improvisations, and The Great Silence with multimedia artist Andrew Quinn.

items.name: Sónar+D
items.why:
Creativity and technology congress inside Sónar.
fits: Your hybrid compositions and electroacoustic music, and The Great Silence's work with multimedia artist Andrew Quinn.

items.name: Auditorium Parco della Musica
items.why:
Rome's main music venue, with contemporary and crossover programming.
fits: Rhapsody in Blue, Concord Sonata with the Marilyn sculpture, and your trio piece Somewhere In My Heart. Your trio debuted at Auditorium Rai FVG in Trieste on 11 Sept 2024.

items.name: Triennale Milano
items.why:
Design/art institution with a live music and performance programme (Triennale Estate, FOG).
fits: The Great Silence, made with architect Alfonso Firmani and sculptor Calogero Condello, and your architecture and environment studies at Liceo Artistico G. Sello.

items.name: Pirelli HangarBicocca
items.why:
Large-scale installation space; immersive sound works fit its programme.
fits: The Great Silence (with sculptor Calogero Condello, architect Alfonso Firmani and multimedia artist Andrew Quinn) and your conceptual art exercises.

items.name: Fondazione Merz
items.why:
Contemporary art foundation with sound and performance projects.
fits: Concord Sonata played with Franco Maschio's sculpture Marilyn, a meeting of sculpture and performance, and your conceptual art exercises.

items.name: Galleria Continua
items.why:
International gallery born in Tuscany, open to installation and performance.
fits: The Great Silence, made with more than fifty artists, and the Marilyn sculpture performances of Ives's Concord Sonata.

items.name: Erased Tapes
items.why:
Label of modern-classical and piano-electronic artists (Nils Frahm, Ólafur Arnalds).
fits: Your piano work and electroacoustic music, with degrees with top marks and honours in Piano and Chamber Music.

items.name: Mercury KX
items.why:
Label for post-classical and piano-led crossover music.
fits: Your piano-led crossover range: Rhapsody in Blue and Concord Sonata alongside your lo-fi and electroacoustic productions.

items.name: Sonic Pieces
items.why:
Small label for intimate piano and ambient records with crafted physical editions.
fits: Your trio piece Somewhere In My Heart and your polytonal chamber music, plus your art book project.

items.name: Mikey Rukus
items.why:
AEW's in-house composer, writing wrestling entrance music.
fits: You wrote wrestling news reports and in-depth articles from 2016, and you write hip-hop and music for others (Duo En Blanc Et Noir, Trio Ives, short films by Valentina Ercolini).

items.name: All Elite Wrestling (AEW)
items.why:
Wrestling promotion that commissions entrance music.
fits: Your wrestling journalism from 2016 and your hip-hop and lo-fi productions, a basis for an entrance-music pitch.
